encode_sentences_on_hpu: encode a list of sentences into embeddings using a SentenceTransformer model on Habana Gaudi HPU
encode_with_prompt: encode sentences with a custom prompt prefix prepended to each sentence before computing embeddings
encode_with_quantization: encode sentences and quantize embeddings to int8, uint8, binary, or ubinary precision for smaller storage
encode_token_embeddings: encode sentences and return token-level embeddings instead of pooled sentence embeddings
encode_normalized_embeddings: encode sentences and normalize the output embeddings to unit length for dot-product similarity
